ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous fields located in the central and lower-lateral regions of both lobes. High-density black pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle intersection, the median notch, and the trailing edge margins. Fine-grained black mottling is visible within the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an approximate pixel angle of 130 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 0.12 relative to the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary containing high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) serrations. Distal tips show higher-amplitude (5-8 pixel) jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Parabolic convex curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonies) located on the distal tips of both lobes. Approximately 12-15 discrete white focal points are distributed within the central dark region and right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, notably three parallel diagonal lines on the mid-left lobe and several intersecting streaks on the central-right lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on the distal trailing edges; extensive linear rake mark scarring on both lobes; multiple small circular focal scars (depigmented spots) in the central dark region.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark pigment island isolated within the white field toward the distal end of the right lobe.
